subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Welcome – Lesson 1: Meet the WOW! Magazine
outcomes: I can say what the WOW! Magazine is.
I can ask and answer questions about me and my partner.
I can name the four WOW! Team members.

tf.s: WOW! stands for World of Wonder!
tf.why: Great! WOW! means World of Wonder!

tf.s: You can buy the WOW! Magazine in the shops.
tf.why: WOW! is an online magazine, so you read it online.

tf.s: The WOW! Magazine is made by kids for kids.
tf.why: Yes! Kids make it for other kids.

tf.s: The WOW! Team asks students for ideas before choosing topics.
tf.why: Right! They ask you first, then they choose the topics.

tf.s: There are six members in the WOW! Team.
tf.why: The team has four members: Reem, Sultan, Arlo and Julia.
Yes, Huda's comment is about cooking.

tf.s: Faisal wants to read about sports cars around the world.
tf.why: Faisal wants to read about traditional clothes around the world.

tf.s: Rahaf went to a museum in the holidays.
tf.why: Correct! That is why she wants to know about the past.

tf.s: Omaima had a new computer from her mum.
tf.why: Omaima's new computer was from her dad.

tf.s: "What's your favourite hobby?" is a good question to ask a new classmate.
tf.why: Yes! It helps you learn about your new friend.

boxes.why: Basil loves sports and wants to be happy and healthy.

boxes.q: Faisal wants to read about ___ clothes.
boxes.why: Faisal is interested in traditional clothes around the world.

boxes.q: "Good morning, and ___ to the start of this new school year."
boxes.why: We say welcome to greet people.
We answer "How old…?" with an age.

boxes.q: A ___ is something a reader writes about a page.
boxes.why: A comment is what a reader writes.
A recipe tells you how to cook something.

boxes.q: Who chooses the topics for the magazine?
boxes.why: The WOW! Team chooses topics after asking you.

hunt.q: He wants to read about clothes.

mcq.q: How many members are in the WOW! Team?
mcq.why: Reem, Sultan, Arlo and Julia make four.

mcq.q: Which list has the WOW! Team members?
mcq.why: The team is Reem, Sultan, Arlo and Julia.

mcq.q: Which is the best description of WOW!?
o: the magazine made by kids for kids
a magazine you buy in the shops
mcq.why: WOW! is made by kids for kids.

mcq.q: What did Omaima get from her dad?
mcq.why: Omaima had a new computer from her dad.

mcq.q: Your new classmate asks, "Why are you learning English?" Which is a good answer?
Which question asks about free time?
mcq.why: A hobby is what you do in your free time.

mcq.q: You love adventures. Which sentence can you say?
o: I want to read about camping because I love adventures.
I want to read about recipes because I love adventures.
I'm medium height because I love adventures.
I love adventures because I'm eleven.
mcq.why: Camping is an adventure, so the reason matches.

mcq.q: Why does the WOW! Team ask students for ideas?
o: to choose topics that are interesting for students
to sell the magazine in shops
mcq.why: They want topics students will enjoy.

mcq.q: Why does Rahaf want to know about places in the past?
o: because she went to a museum in the holidays
because she got a new computer
mcq.why: Her museum visit made her interested in the past.

mcq.q: Which two readers want to learn how to stay healthy?
mcq.why: Basil and Hisham both talk about being healthy.
